crusadecraft.lineage.title: Register of Lineages
crusadecraft.lineage.open.tip: The houses, families and communities of the world: create them, generate them, bring them to life.
crusadecraft.lineage.of_realm.tip: Open the house ruling this realm: its ruler, family, heir and councillors.
crusadecraft.lineage.new_house.tip: A noble family over several generations, generated in one click.
crusadecraft.lineage.new_community.tip: A village, a guild, an order, a company… and its people.
crusadecraft.lineage.grow.house.tip: One more generation: the adults of the last generation marry and have children.
crusadecraft.lineage.spawn.all.tip: Brings every living member near you as Comes Alive villagers (16 at most at once).
crusadecraft.lineage.spawn.one.tip: Brings this person near you as a Comes Alive villager.
crusadecraft.lineage.tree.tip: Writes everyone into the Comes Alive family tree, without spawning anyone.
crusadecraft.lineage.adopt.tip: Adds the Comes Alive villagers around you (16 blocks) here, with their family ties.
crusadecraft.lineage.remove.house.tip: Removes the house and its members from the register. Villagers already in the world stay.
crusadecraft.lineage.remove.community.ti: Removes the community and its people from the register. Villagers already in the world stay.
crusadecraft.lineage.role.tip: Changes their role (and their villager's profession). Shift-click: cycle backwards.
crusadecraft.lineage.child.tip: A child of this person and their spouse.
crusadecraft.lineage.marry.tip: Finds them a spouse: noble for a house, commoner for a community.
crusadecraft.lineage.no_mca.hint: Install Minecraft Comes Alive to bring these people to life as villagers.
crusadecraft.lineage.empty.houses: No house yet. AI realms get theirs as soon as you know them.
crusadecraft.lineage.empty.communities: No community. Create a village, a guild or an order with the button below.
crusadecraft.lineage.pick.house: Pick a house on the left.
crusadecraft.lineage.pick.community: Pick a community on the left.
crusadecraft.lineage.readonly: You are reading the register. Only the game's host and operators can change it.
crusadecraft.lineage.form.realm.tip: The realm it serves. A house tied to a realm becomes its ruling family.
crusadecraft.lineage.form.generations.ti: From 1 (a couple) to 5 (long-dead great-great-grandparents down to their descendants).
crusadecraft.lineage.form.kind.tip: A village or a clan has families; an order, a company or a monastery has single members.
crusadecraft.lineage.form.size.tip: How many households (or members) to generate.
crusadecraft.lineage.realm_has_house: This realm already has its ruling house.
crusadecraft.lineage.too_young: %s is too young to have children.
crusadecraft.lineage.removed: %s is no longer in the register.
crusadecraft.lineage.grow_none: Nobody is old enough to have children.
crusadecraft.lineage.no_mca: Minecraft Comes Alive is needed to bring people to life.
crusadecraft.lineage.spawn.elsewhere: They are already somewhere in the world, out of reach.
crusadecraft.lineage.spawn.none: Nobody to summon: the dead stay in the register.
crusadecraft.lineage.tree.done: %s people written into the Comes Alive family tree.
crusadecraft.lineage.adopt.none: No Comes Alive villager to register around you.
crusadecraft.codex.lignees.p0: The $(l)Register of lineages$() keeps the noble houses, families and communities of the world. Open it from the $(l)House$() screen or the map editor. Every AI realm has its court there: ruler, family, heir, councillors.
crusadecraft.codex.lignees.p1: The game's host creates houses over several generations, villages, guilds and orders. With $(l)Minecraft Comes Alive$(), "Summon" brings them to life as villagers, family tree included.
